properties.name: text
hand: written invalidates the page and its owning TabControl

properties.name: image_key
hand: a view: a write clears image_index, so an equal key still writes when an index is set
properties.comment: The tab's image in the TabControl's image list, by key (Windows Forms' ImageKey). A write clears image_index, as in Windows Forms; an empty key shows no image, and so does a key the list does not have. A key that is not valid UTF-8 or is longer than 256 bytes throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: image_index
hand: a view: a write clears image_key, so an equal index still writes when a key is set
properties.comment: The tab's image in the TabControl's image list, by index (Windows Forms' ImageIndex). A write clears image_key; -1 (the default) shows no image, and so does an index the list does not have. An index below -1 throws std::out_of_range.
